A warning every teenager needs, and they need to hear it from YOU. 🚗⚠️

Lydia is sixteen. First night drive, Mom in the passenger seat. Along the road, Mom tells her:
1️⃣ Not every friend is a friend.
2️⃣ We won't be here forever. Notice the people who ask "Did you eat?" ⏳
3️⃣ Social media isn't real. Don't compare your behind-the-scenes to someone's highlight reel. 📱
4️⃣ One bad decision can change everything. Think before you say yes.
5️⃣ You don't have to fit in. Find your people.
6️⃣ Screenshots exist. Think about what feels funny now. 📸
7️⃣ Walk away. Sometimes that's the strongest thing you can do.
8️⃣ Don't rush to grow up. 🛑

"But what if I get it wrong?" Lydia asks. "Then call me. I'll come and get you." ❤️

"I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life." John 8:12 (ESV) 🙏 Jesus went to the cross for every wrong turn.

Four years later, Lydia is twenty, far from home. Her phone lights up: "Did you eat?" 🥹

But don't wait for sixteen. Half of anxiety disorders have already started by age 11 (Kessler et al., 2005). Start the conversations now. ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
